notes: UI-only live equipment scan; combat remains 0.7.10.7 unchanged. Panel now reads the actually equipped chest clothing/armor on every live refresh and shows self-defense telemetry aggregated from currently worn/equipped item properties plus spell resistance. Effective STR/DEX/CHA/AC were already live totals, so gear changes are visible without hard-coding a build. This is the first equipment-aware capability layer before generalizing AI decisions to all companions.
